exercises.title: TOM SAWYER: THE FENCE
pages: On Saturday morning the summer world was bright and warm, and every boy in the town was free. Tom came to the fence with a bucket of white paint. The fence was long and high. His aunt Polly said: «Paint the fence, and do not leave until you finish.»

Tom painted a little, then sat down. It was terrible. Soon Ben came by, eating a big red apple. «Ha-ha! You have to WORK today!» he laughed. Tom did not answer. He painted slowly, like an artist, and looked at the fence like a museum painting. «What is so interesting?» asked Ben. «Interesting? Do boys paint fences every day?»

Ben watched. It began to seem fun. «Tom, let me paint a little.» «No. Aunt Polly is very careful about this fence.» «I'll give you the apple!» Tom allowed him to paint and ate the apple. Other boys came to laugh — and stayed to work. Each of them paid Tom something: a marble, a kite, a dead rat on a string. By afternoon the fence had three coats of paint, and Tom was rich. He had learned a great law of human nature: in order to make a person want a thing, it is only necessary to make the thing difficult to get.

exercises.prompt: Why did Tom have to paint the fence?
options: His aunt Polly told him to.
exercises.explain: Тётя Полли велит Тому покрасить забор и не уходить до конца работы.

options: Slowly and carefully, like an artist.
He did not paint at all.
exercises.explain: Том красит slowly, like an artist — медленно, как художник.

exercises.prompt: What did Ben give Tom for the chance to paint?
exercises.explain: Бен предлагает яблоко: I’ll give you the apple!

exercises.prompt: Why did the boys want to paint?
options: Tom made the work look difficult and interesting.
exercises.explain: Том изображает покраску редкой привилегией; Бен начинает считать её интересной.

exercises.prompt: What is Tom's «great law of human nature»?
options: People want what is difficult to get.
exercises.explain: Финальная мысль текста: недоступная вещь кажется желаннее.
Pretend to be + состояние; pretended — прошедшее.
Give → gave; кому + что. Допустимо gave an apple to Tom.
